suppress.notes: False-positive CPE association: the internal Maven module io.github.fturleque:morpheus-store-sqlite:1.2.2 is MORPHEUS code, not SQLite 1.2.2. The actual runtime driver is independently scanned as org.xerial:sqlite-jdbc:3.54.1.0. base="true" exempts this rule from failBuildOnUnusedSuppressionRule, and only this rule: whether the association happens depends on the history of the vulnerability database. The long-lived CI database makes it; a database built from scratch, by the NVD API or by the NVD data feeds, files cpe:/a:sqlite:sqlite under the native ecosystem and does not (measured with Dependency-Check 13.0.0 on 2026-10-28). The rule must therefore not fail the scan when it matches nothing. See RT-13 in docs/architecture/risks/register.md.

CVE-2026-119586 is a command injection in the SQLite command-line shell (the .recover dot-command of shell.c, "through 3.54.1"). The library that sqlite-jdbc extracts (sqlitejdbc.dll, libsqlitejdbc.so, ...) is the SQLite engine built without the shell: MORPHEUS never runs the sqlite3 program and ships none. The rule names this CVE only, and only on the natives extracted from org.xerial:sqlite-jdbc; every other CVE of cpe:/a:sqlite:sqlite stays scanned. base="true" exempts it from failBuildOnUnusedSuppressionRule: whether Dependency-Check orders 3.54.1.0 after "3.54.1" decides whether it matches. Remove it when the NVD record or a later driver clears it. See RT-13 in docs/architecture/risks/register.md.

False-positive CPE association introduced by the aggregate coverage module: io.github.fturleque:morpheus-cli:1.2.2 is the MORPHEUS command-line adapter, not GitHub CLI 1.2.2. This rule removes only the github:cli CPE from that exact internal package URL; all third-party dependencies of morpheus-cli remain scanned.
